Independently reconstruct the exact target and polynomial identity, verify all denominator signs and the exhaustive substitution, and justify every tied minimum part and every within-part edge.
Check coefficient and grouped-display identities with a separately written implementation, not only an author-provided pass flag. Finite cases are diagnostic only.
Replay the selected portable checker and check that altered coefficients and malformed certificates fail. Preserve raw commands, stdout, stderr, return codes and failures.
Inspect the prior-art source investigator's corrected v2 packet. Its author also wrote branch 2, so it cannot supply independent final proof or novelty certification.

Keep mathematical validity, source scope, publication novelty and demonstrated practical impact separate. The exact starting identity is known; no result for four or more non-singleton parts is asserted.
publication: Preserve all author and failed-probe records locally. Do not redistribute full primary papers or full-page source renderings; publish source metadata and original proof/checker work. Agreement between three authors is not an independent evidence gate.
